prompt: Name a US state that borders one of the Great Lakes.
label: Getting Harder
source: US Environmental Protection Agency, Great Lakes basin: https://www.epa.gov/greatlakes
valueLogic: Michigan and New York are immediate. Illinois and Ohio follow. The tail is Indiana and Pennsylvania, both of which touch a lake along only a short stretch of one border and both of which are consistently missed.
note: Eight states. Ontario borders four of the lakes but is a Canadian province; it and the states that never touch a lake are non-busting distractors.

answers.name: Michigan
answers.fact: Touches four of the five, more than any other state, and is the only one split in two by them.

answers.name: New York
answers.fact: Borders Erie and Ontario, and is the only state touching Lake Ontario.

answers.name: Illinois
answers.fact: About 63 miles of Lake Michigan shoreline, including all of Chicago's lakefront.

answers.name: Ohio
answers.fact: Most of its northern border is Lake Erie.

answers.name: Minnesota
answers.fact: Touches Superior only, at the lake's western tip, where Duluth sits.

answers.name: Indiana
answers.fact: About 45 miles of Lake Michigan, the shortest Great Lakes shoreline of any state, and routinely forgotten.

answers.name: Pennsylvania
answers.fact: A short stretch of Lake Erie around the city of Erie, and the hardest of the eight to name.

distractors.name: Ontario
distractors.note: Borders four of the five lakes, but is a Canadian province.

distractors.name: Iowa
distractors.note: In the broader region, but touches no Great Lake.

distractors.name: Vermont
distractors.note: Borders Lake Champlain, which is not one of the Great Lakes.

distractors.name: Lake Champlain
distractors.note: A lake, not a state - and not one of the Great Lakes either.

distractors.name: Quebec
distractors.note: A Canadian province, and does not border a Great Lake.
